bibl.title: Alphabetic Verses and Cipher Alphabets from Western Theban Monasteries: Perspectives on Monastic Literacy in Late Antique Egypt.
bibl.seg: Anastasia Maravela, Alphabetic Verses and Cipher Alphabets from Western Theban Monasteries: Perspectives on Monastic Literacy in Late Antique Egypt.
Erika Juhász (ed.), Byzanz und das Abendland III. Studia Byzantino-Occidentalia = Antiquitas, Byzantium, Renascentia. 15 = Bibliotheca Byzantina. 3 (Budapest, 2015) pp. 67-83.
bibl.note: Exploration and documentation of the Christian phase at Western Thebes. - "School texts" from Western Theban Monasteries. - The wooden board T. Mon. Epiph. 616 (= MP3 1597; LDAB 210). - O. Deir el-Bachit 21 (= LDAB 128462). - Concluding remarks.
